title: Outdoor Grilled Australian Blackberry Skewers
description: A rich and energizing Australian dish featuring blackberries and a char-grill flavor, perfect for a snack or dessert. This high-protein friendly recipe is cooked to perfection in a bamboo steamer.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, around 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the Greek yogurt, honey, and protein powder until well combined.
Add the granola, coconut flakes, and lemon zest to the bowl and stir until a crumbly mixture forms.
Thread the Australian blackberries onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each blackberry.
Brush the grill with a small amount of oil to prevent sticking.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the blackberries are tender and slightly charred.
Serve the grilled blackberry skewers with the yogurt mixture spooned over the top.
Garnish with additional coconut flakes and lemon zest if desired.
